This compound is implicated in the target pathway through multiple routes, with Luzonoid C acting as a common mediator. Both the compound and Luzonoid C are shown to interact with Potassium channel subfamily K member 9 and Carbonic anhydrase 5B, mitochondrial, which in turn are targets of Luzonoid C and ultimately lead to the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The evidence is supported by a chain of targets, suggesting a possible role in anion transport or cellular homeostasis. The integration of these pathways implies that the compound may influence cellular processes involving ion transport and metabolic regulation, though the exact mechanism remains to be fully elucidated.
